name: avatar-circles
title: Avatar Circles
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AvatarCircles } from '@/components/ui/avatar-circles'

const avatars = [
  { imageUrl: 'https://avatar.vercel.sh/jack', profileUrl: 'https://github.com/jack' },
  { imageUrl: 'https://avatar.vercel.sh/jill', profileUrl: 'https://github.com/jill' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <AvatarCircles :num-people="99" :avatar-urls="avatars" />
</template>

examples.name: avatar-circles-sizes
examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Resize the circles and overlap from `class`.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the row. Change the overlap with `-space-x-*`, the size with `[&_img]:size-*`.

props.name: numPeople
props.description: Number shown in the last circle (“+99”). The circle is hidden when this is 0 or omitted.

props.name: avatarUrls
props.description: The avatars, each linking to its profile (opens in a new tab).
